title: Not for my cat
text: I really wish I could give this a 5 star review but unfortunately my cat is not a fan! I’ve bought her a box twice. First time was a few years ago and she was momentarily amused. There’s one toy she still loves. But this last box she was not entertained at all. The first whiff of catnip got her excited but ten minutes later she was bored. I know other cats love them so I guess it depends on your cat
label: neutral
